scientifically.example: This ensures that participants can't tell whether they're receiving the real treatment or the placebo, which in turn keeps the study fair and the results scientifically reliable.
scientifically.example_cn: 这确保了参与者无法分辨他们接受的是真正治疗还是安慰剂，从而保持研究的公正性，使结果在科学上可靠。

screwed.example: Wow, I'd forget my head if it wasn't screwed on.
screwed.example_cn: 哇，要不是脑袋是拧在脖子上的，我连它都能忘掉。

shoes.example: Make sure to bring water, snacks and comfortable shoes.
shoes.example_cn: 务必带上水、零食和舒适的鞋子。

shutting.example: It keeps freezing and shutting down randomly.
shutting.example_cn: 它老是卡死，还动不动就自动关机。

sidetracked.example: I was planning to go, but I got completely sidetracked helping my cousin move into her new apartment.
sidetracked.example_cn: 我本来打算去的，结果帮我表姐搬家，注意力就完全跑偏了。

signings.example: There will be author readings and book signings.
signings.example_cn: 届时会有作者朗读和签售活动。

ski.example: I heard you're planning a trip to Sky-High Ski Resort this winter.
ski.example_cn: 我听说你计划今年冬天去天高滑雪度假村旅行。

skis.example: Well, I've booked the cabin to stay, but I still need to reserve skis and ski boots.
skis.example_cn: 嗯，我已经预订了住的小木屋，但还需要预约滑雪板和滑雪靴。

slides.example: I still need to finalize my slides and add a couple more visuals to make it engaging.
slides.example_cn: 我还需要敲定我的幻灯片，再加几张视觉素材，让演示更有吸引力。

smartphone.example: I'm trying to decide whether to get a smartphone or a tablet.
smartphone.example_cn: 我正在纠结是买智能手机还是平板电脑。

snacks.example: Make sure to bring water, snacks and comfortable shoes.
snacks.example_cn: 务必带上水、零食和舒适的鞋子。

sneakers.example: Though the reviews of the sneakers I bought last month said they're super-durable, and yet I have holes in them already.
sneakers.example_cn: 虽然我上个月买的运动鞋评论都说超级耐穿，但我已经把它穿出洞了。

states.example: Its history begins in the southern United States.
states.example_cn: 它的历史始于美国南部。

steak.example: The steak we ate at your parents' place last week was fabulous.
steak.example_cn: 上周在你父母家吃的牛排真是棒极了。

stimulation.example: Neuroplasticity allows the brain to adapt in response to learning, experience, and other stimulation.
stimulation.example_cn: 神经可塑性使大脑能够根据学习、经验和外部刺激进行自我调整。

submitted.example: We're looking for stories on the theme of family, and all stories must be submitted by the end of November to be considered.
submitted.example_cn: 我们正在征集以家庭为主题的故事，所有作品须在十一月底前提交方可参选。

substances.example: Today, I want to talk about a fascinating topic in chemistry: catalysts — substances that speed up chemical reactions without being used up.
substances.example_cn: 今天，我想聊一聊化学中一个引人入胜的话题：催化剂——即能加速化学反应而自身不被消耗的物质。

tablet.example: I'm trying to decide whether to get a smartphone or a tablet.
tablet.example_cn: 我正在纠结是买智能手机还是平板电脑。

technician.example: Yes, I called the technician this morning.
technician.example_cn: 是的，我今天早上给维修技术员打了电话。

thai.example: By the way, there's a great Thai restaurant next to the resort, and I don't think it requires reservations.
thai.example_cn: 对了，度假村旁边有家很棒的泰国餐厅，我觉得应该不需要预订。

thesis.example: This draft should include your thesis statement, main arguments, and a preliminary list of sources.
thesis.example_cn: 这份初稿应包含你的论文论点、主要论证以及初步的参考文献列表。

thrilled.example: We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual charity auction will be held next Saturday at six PM in the main hall.
thrilled.example_cn: 我们激动地宣布，大学年度慈善拍卖会将于下周六下午六点在大礼堂举行。

thriller.example: Did you see that new thriller movie that came out last week?
thriller.example_cn: 你看了上周上映的那部新惊悚片了吗？

tons.example: A carbon footprint measures the total amount of greenhouse gases produced directly and indirectly by human activities, usually expressed in equivalent tons of carbon dioxide.
tons.example_cn: 碳足迹衡量人类活动直接和间接产生的温室气体总量，通常以二氧化碳当量吨数表示。

unchanged.example: Think of them as helpful assistants that make reactions happen faster and more efficiently, while staying unchanged.
unchanged.example_cn: 可以把它们想象成热心的助手，能让反应进行得更快更高效，同时自身保持不变。

uncomfortably.example: It's getting uncomfortably warm in here.
uncomfortably.example_cn: 这里面热得让人不舒服了。

uneaten.example: Now, any uneaten food can be placed into a compost bin.
uneaten.example_cn: 现在，任何未食用的食物都可以放入堆肥箱中。

unobservable.example: Despite being unobservable directly, it's believed to make up about 27 percent of the universe's mass-energy content.
unobservable.example_cn: 尽管无法直接观测，但据信它约占宇宙质能总量的百分之二十七。

unrelated.example: Not a single thought occurred to me that was unrelated to the movie.
unrelated.example_cn: 我脑子里连一个与电影无关的念头都没出现过。

unseen.example: This anomaly suggests that a massive, unseen matter is exerting gravitational force, keeping the stars moving faster than expected.
unseen.example_cn: 这一异常现象表明，存在大量不可见的物质在施加引力，使得恒星的运动速度超出预期。

update.example: Due to some recent changes in university policy, we need everyone to update their contact information in the student portal.
update.example_cn: 由于学校政策近期有所变动，需要大家在学生门户网站上更新联系方式。

urgent.example: If you have an urgent need to meet with me and these times don't work for you, please email me and I can schedule an appointment.
urgent.example_cn: 如果你有紧急需求想见我而这些时间都不方便，请发邮件给我，我可以另行安排预约。

veggie.example: I was thinking more along the lines of veggie lasagna.
veggie.example_cn: 我想的更多是蔬菜千层面那种风格的。

waggle.example: One of the most fascinating aspects of their behavior is the waggle dance.
waggle.example_cn: 它们行为中最引人入胜的一个方面就是摇摆舞。

worn.example: Yes, I am, but I realized my old mat is completely worn out.
worn.example_cn: 是的，我是打算去，但我发现我的旧垫子已经完全磨坏了。

worthwhile.example: They might help you decide if the extra cost would be worthwhile.
worthwhile.example_cn: 它们也许能帮你判断多花的钱是否值得。

wow.example: Wow, I'd forget my head if it wasn't screwed on.
wow.example_cn: 哇，要不是脑袋是拧在脖子上的，我连它都能忘掉。
